ABSTRACT

In contemporary corporate human resources and technical recruitment, organizations are confronted with unprecedented volumes of applicant resumes for specialized engineering positions. Traditional applicant tracking systems (ATS) operate primarily on rigid keyword density matching, making them highly susceptible to artificial keyword stuffing while frequently rejecting highly qualified candidates due to non-standard resume typography or layout formatting. Furthermore, applicants are routinely rejected without transparent feedback regarding which technical proficiencies they lacked, leading to significant recruiter fatigue and opaque candidate experiences.

To resolve these critical structural bottlenecks, this project presents HireIQ, an enterprise-grade AI-powered applicant tracking and talent gap intelligence platform developed by Team ERROR 404. HireIQ implements a resilient multi-tier architecture uniting a high-performance React 19 single-page application, an Express.js enterprise REST gateway, an asynchronous FastAPI Python AI microservice, and a decoupled Prisma ORM data layer supporting dual SQLite and PostgreSQL databases.

HireIQ pioneers dual-portal recruitment operations. For corporate recruiters, it delivers automated multi-format PDF and Word DOCX ingestion, deterministic skill dictionary extraction, dynamic hiring threshold benchmarks, date-filtered performance analytics, and an immutable audit trail. For candidates, it delivers a transparent ATS career console featuring real-time readability calculations (97%), role competency matching (90%), structural compliance audits (97%), categorized skill inventories, and an interactive AI career guidance copilot. This report details the architectural design, algorithmic implementation, empirical testing, security posture, and college submission requirements of the HireIQ platform.

CHAPTER 1

Introduction

1.1 Project Overview & Background

In the modern digital recruitment landscape, talent acquisition teams receive hundreds—often thousands—of curriculum vitae (CVs) and resumes for every open corporate role. The widespread availability of one-click job applications has dramatically accelerated application volume, overwhelming corporate human resources departments and technical recruiters.

HireIQ is an advanced AI-powered web platform engineered specifically to automate and transform the traditional hiring lifecycle. Developed under the Project-Based Learning (PBL) curriculum by Team ERROR 404, HireIQ bridges the operational divide between hiring managers seeking precise technical competencies and job seekers navigating opaque recruitment filters.

The platform features a dual-portal architecture: an enterprise Recruiter Talent Console designed for high-throughput candidate screening, workforce skill gap auditing, and hiring benchmark governance; and an intuitive Candidate Career Console providing applicants with transparent ATS compliance evaluations, verified skill indexing, and AI-driven career guidance.

1.2 Problem Statement & Industry Bottlenecks

  • Manual Screening Fatigue: Human evaluation of resumes requires 5 to 7 minutes per candidate. Across hundreds of applications, recruiter cognitive fatigue results in arbitrary shortlisting and overlooked engineering talent.
  • Brittle Keyword-Matching ATS: Legacy Applicant Tracking Systems rely on primitive exact-string keyword counting. Candidates who understand these algorithms engage in 'keyword stuffing' to artificially inflate match scores, while qualified candidates with non-standard formatting or synonymous phrasing are disqualified.
  • Opaque Candidate Feedback: Traditional recruitment processes operate as information black boxes. Candidates receive automated rejection notices without actionable feedback regarding missing technical requirements or formatting errors, preventing professional growth.

1.3 Project Objectives

  • Multi-Format Document Ingestion: Implement high-fidelity native text stream extraction from PDF and DOCX files without external OCR dependencies, achieving sub-second parsing speeds.
  • Structured Skill Inventory Extraction: Catalog extracted technical competencies into standardized operational categories including Programming Languages, Web & Database Technologies, Core Computer Science, and Professional Soft Skills.
  • Dynamic Skill Gap & Workforce Intelligence: Compute real-time candidate match percentages against corporate role benchmarks, identifying precise technical deficits and generating personalized upskilling roadmaps.
  • Dual-Role Access Governance: Enforce strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) separating administrative recruiter workflows from private candidate career consoles via stateless JSON Web Tokens.
  • Transparent Candidate Audit Console: Provide applicants with calculated ATS readiness metrics—including character readability, role competency alignment, and single-column structural compliance—eliminating arbitrary hiring opacity.
  • Immutable Security & Audit Logging: Maintain a tamper-evident audit log recording all recruiter decisions, stage transitions, and document evaluations for enterprise accountability.
CHAPTER 4

System Architecture & Design

4.1 3-Tier Distributed Architecture

HireIQ implements a decoupled 3-tier enterprise architecture ensuring fault tolerance, strict separation of concerns, and independent scalability across presentation, gateway orchestration, and AI execution layers.

+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ | PRESENTATION TIER: REACT 19 SPA (PORT 5173) | | - Executive Recruiter Dashboard (Telemetry Bento Grid, Velocity Analytics) | | - Candidate Management Table (Stage Transitions, Role Association) | | - Candidate Career Console (Dynamic Readability 97%, Competency 90%, ATS 97%) | | - Split-View ATS Resume Checker & Integrated AI Career Copilot Drawer | +----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ │ HTTP REST / JWT Bearer Authentication ▼ +----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ | APPLICATION GATEWAY: EXPRESS.JS REST API (PORT 5000) | | - JWT Authentication, Bcrypt Hashing, RBAC Middleware (Admin/Recruiter/Cand) | | - Multi-Part Stream Handlers (Multer 1.4, pdf-parse, mammoth DOCX parser) | | - Deterministic Skill Extraction Engine & Gap Benchmark Matcher | | - Date-Filtered Analytics Aggregator & Immutable Audit Logger | +----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ │ │ Prisma ORM ▼ Internal REST ▼ Async Microservice +---------------------------------------+ +--------------------------------------+ | PERSISTENCE LAYER | | AI MICROSERVICE (PORT 8000) | | - SQLite (dev.db) / PostgreSQL | | - FastAPI (Python 3.14) | | - 13 Relations (User, Candidate, | | - Pydantic Validation Schemas | | Resume, Analysis, JobRole, Skills) | | - Gemini 2.5 Flash LLM Integration | | - Parameterized Query Security | | - Qualitative Roadmap Synthesis | +---------------------------------------+ +--------------------------------------+

4.2 End-to-End Processing Flow

When a resume file (PDF or DOCX) is uploaded, the request is intercepted by Multer, verified against MIME constraints, and streamed to pdf-parse or mammoth. A clean plaintext stream (1,496 characters in the case of candidate Surja Kanta Chowdhury) is extracted with zero OCR overhead. The stream is evaluated against the database Skill dictionary, cataloging 18 verified competencies. The record is committed to Prisma within an atomic transaction while the FastAPI microservice evaluates qualitative strengths and generates contextual interview questions.

Conclusion

The HireIQ AI Resume Scanning and Skill Gapping project successfully fulfills all objectives established for this Project-Based Learning curriculum. Developed by Team ERROR 404, the platform resolves long-standing inefficiencies in traditional corporate recruitment by combining deterministic skill verification with state-of-the-art generative AI contextual synthesis.

By offering dual-portal capabilities—empowering enterprise recruiters with automated screening, benchmark governance, and immutable audit logs, while providing candidates with calculated ATS readiness diagnostics and career guidance—HireIQ establishes a benchmark in modern talent acquisition software engineering. The implementation stands fully tested, verified, and ready for academic submission and technical defense.
